brief.title: Global Intentional Homicide Trends: A Multi-Dimensional Analysis (1990–2023)
brief.one_liner: A comprehensive trend analysis of intentional homicide rates across countries, sexes, and age groups over three decades, drawing on UNODC data.
brief.goal: Equip policy analysts and public safety stakeholders with a clear understanding of how homicide rates have evolved globally, which regions and demographics face the highest risk, and where notable improvements or deteriorations have occurred, to inform evidence-based policy recommendations.

required_sections.title: Global Homicide Rate Overview
required_sections.objective: Present the overall global trend in homicide rates from 1990 to 2023, including the number of countries reporting, the global median and mean rates over time, and a high-level summary of whether the world is becoming safer or more dangerous.

required_sections.title: Regional & Country-Level Comparison
required_sections.objective: Identify the countries and regions with the highest and lowest homicide rates, highlight the top 10 and bottom 10 countries by most recent available year, and discuss geographic patterns.

required_sections.title: Gender Disparity in Homicide Victimization
required_sections.objective: Analyze the difference in homicide rates between males and females globally and across selected countries, quantifying the male-to-female ratio and how it has changed over time.

required_sections.title: Age Group Analysis
required_sections.objective: Examine which age groups face the highest homicide risk, identify patterns across countries, and assess whether youth or elderly populations are disproportionately affected.

required_sections.title: Notable Country-Level Trends & Outliers
required_sections.objective: Highlight countries with the most dramatic increases or decreases in homicide rates over the observation period, discuss potential contextual factors, and flag statistical outliers.

required_sections.title: Data Limitations & Policy Recommendations
required_sections.objective: Discuss the unbalanced panel nature of the dataset, reporting gaps, and caveats (e.g., UK data covering only England and Wales). Provide actionable policy recommendations based on the findings.

kpis.name: Global Median Homicide Rate
kpis.description: The median homicide rate (per 100,000 population) across all countries for the most recent available year, providing a robust central tendency measure.

kpis.name: Male-to-Female Homicide Rate Ratio
kpis.description: The ratio of male homicide rate to female homicide rate globally, indicating the degree of gender disparity in victimization.

kpis.name: Highest National Homicide Rate
kpis.description: The peak homicide rate observed among all countries in the most recent year with data, identifying the most affected nation.

kpis.name: Decade-over-Decade Change
kpis.description: The percentage change in the global average homicide rate between successive decades (e.g., 2000s vs. 2010s vs. 2020s) to capture long-term trajectory.

kpis.name: Reporting Coverage Rate
kpis.description: The proportion of countries with available homicide data in any given year, reflecting data completeness and global monitoring capacity.
